title: Operation: Copy This File
objective: Recover the USB drive someone found in the parking lot.
dialogue: Rob: Someone plugged it in. I watched it happen. I could not stop it in time.
Andrew: It was labeled 'SALARIES_2026'. Of course it was.
Luna (Pet): *sniff* smells like regret and cheap plastic.

triviaRiddle.question: What should you do with a USB drive you found in the parking lot?
triviaRiddle.hint: Whatever you do, do not plug it in.
